tests.title: Access and Need types expose the specified constants and the new function signatures
given: the wsaccess package
tests.when: the constants are read and AuthorizeWorkspace, AuthorizeWorkspaceAt and workspace.AuthorizeWorkspace are called with a Need argument
then: NeedRead, NeedWrite and NeedPrivate are three distinct Need values
workspace.AuthorizeWorkspace returns the same (access, status, message) as wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace for the same inputs
tests.pseudocode: assert Access("member") == AccessMember; assert len({NeedRead,NeedWrite,NeedPrivate}) == 3; assert workspace.AuthorizeWorkspace(db,a,s,NeedRead) == wsaccess.AuthorizeWorkspace(db,a,s,NeedRead)

tests.title: An admin token is AccessAdmin without reading org_members
given: an in-memory database with a workspaces table holding W with org_id O and NO org_members table
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace is called with an admin token and NeedWrite
then: status is 0 and message is empty
no error arises from the missing org_members table
tests.pseudocode: ws,st,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db, admin, 'w', NeedWrite); assert st==0; assert ws.Access==AccessAdmin

tests.title: The owner is AccessOwner without reading org_members
given: a workspaces table with W owned by U1 with org_id O
no org_members table
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace is called as U1 (api_key) with NeedWrite
tests.pseudocode: ws,st,_ = AuthorizeWorkspace(db, apikey(U1), 'w', NeedWrite); assert st==0 && ws.Access==AccessOwner

tests.title: A user with an org_members row for the workspace's org is a member whatever the org's status or kind
given: W owned by U1 in org O
org_members rows (O,U2) and (P,U3) where P is a personal org with status 'suspended'
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead) is called as U2, and as U3 on a workspace in P

tests.title: A NULL or empty org_id, or an empty UserID, gives AccessNone and 404 without an org_members read
given: workspace W1 with NULL org_id and W2 with org_id ''
workspace W3 with org O
no org_members table
an admin-role api_key with empty UserID and a PAT with empty UserID
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead) is called as a non-owner user on W1 and W2, and as the empty-UserID credentials on W3
tests.pseudocode: for (a,s) in cases: ws,st,msg = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,a,s,NeedRead); assert (ws,st,msg)==(nil,404,'workspace not found')

tests.title: Deleting the membership row takes effect on the next call
given: U2 is a member of O via an org_members row and AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead) succeeds for U2 on W
tests.when: the org_members row is deleted and AuthorizeWorkspace is called again
then: the second call returns (nil, 404, "workspace not found")
tests.pseudocode: assert AuthorizeWorkspace(...).Access==member; db.Exec('DELETE FROM org_members ...'); assert status==404

tests.title: Access is the first matching rule in the order admin, owner, member, none
given: a database with workspaces and org_members tables
tests.when: for any combination of credential type (admin_token, api_key, pat), UserID (empty or one of several), owner_id, org_id (NULL, empty, set) and org_members rows
then: the decided Access equals the model: admin if admin_token; else owner if UserID non-empty and == owner_id; else member if UserID non-empty, org_id non-empty and a row exists; else none
tests.pseudocode: for c in gen_cases(): got = AuthorizeWorkspace(db, c.auth, c.slug, NeedRead); assert accessOf(got) == model(c)

tests.title: A nil auth is refused with 401 without a database query
given: a database handle that has been closed so any query would error
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace is called with nil auth

tests.title: An unknown slug and a stranger get 404 and trigger no bound-refusal report
given: a bound-refusal observer counting calls
a PAT bound to W that is a stranger on W2, and an unknown slug
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace is called for the unknown slug and for the stranger on W2

tests.title: A PAT bound to another workspace is refused with one report carrying the site, whatever its access and need
given: U1 owns A and B; U2 is a member of the org of B; PATs bound to A for U1 and U2
an observer recording sites
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead) is called for B, then AuthorizeWorkspaceAt with a site carrying method GET and route /workspaces/:slug
then: each call produces exactly one report
AuthorizeWorkspace's report has Status 404, Surface SurfaceAPI and no method or route
AuthorizeWorkspaceAt's report carries the given site

tests.title: A member needing write gets 403 and needing private gets 404, after the binding check
given: U2 is a member of W's org
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace is called as U2 with NeedWrite and with NeedPrivate; and as a PAT for U2 bound to another workspace with NeedWrite
then: NeedWrite returns (nil, 403, "org members have read-only access to this workspace")
the bound PAT with NeedWrite gets 404 (binding precedes need) with one report

tests.title: A satisfied need returns the full WorkspaceAccess, with OrgID empty for a NULL column
given: W1 with org_id O owned by U1, W2 with NULL org_id owned by U1
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedWrite) is called as U1 for each
then: W1 result has Slug, OwnerID, OrgID=O, Status, CloneStatus and Access=owner

tests.title: A database error reading the workspace, membership or binding yields 500 and no grant
given: a database where (a) the workspaces table is missing, (b) org_members is missing and the caller is a non-owner, (c) the token-binding table is broken and the caller is a PAT
tests.when: AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead) is called in each case

tests.title: WriteRefusal sets error_type forbidden only on 403
given: an echo context with a recorder
tests.when: WriteRefusal is called with (403, msg), (404, "workspace not found") and (500, "internal server error")
then: 403 body is {error: msg, error_type: "forbidden"} and ErrorTypeForbidden == "forbidden"
404 and 500 bodies have the error field and no error_type key

tests.title: ReadableSlugs for an admin token returns unrestricted without a query
given: a closed database handle
tests.when: ReadableSlugs is called with an admin token

tests.title: ReadableSlugs for nil auth or an empty UserID returns an empty non-nil map without a query
given: a closed database handle
tests.when: ReadableSlugs is called with nil auth, with an api_key with empty UserID and with a PAT with empty UserID
then: each returns (non-nil empty map, false, nil)

tests.title: ReadableSlugs returns owned workspaces as owner and org workspaces as member, all statuses
given: U2 owns W1 (active) and W2 (archived), is a member of org O with W3 (archived) and W4 owned by U1, and also owns W5 in O
W6 in an org U2 does not belong to
tests.when: ReadableSlugs is called as U2

tests.title: A bound PAT gets at most its bound slug, resolved before rows open on a single-connection database
given: a database with SetMaxOpenConns(1)
user U2 with readable set {A, B}
PAT bound to A, PAT bound to C (not readable), and PAT bound to nothing
tests.when: ReadableSlugs is called for each PAT
then: unbound PAT returns the full set

tests.title: A binding lookup or readable-set query failure is returned as an error
given: a database whose workspaces table is dropped, and one whose binding table is broken
tests.when: ReadableSlugs is called as a non-admin user and as a PAT

tests.title: ReadableSlugs agrees exactly with AuthorizeWorkspace(NeedRead)
given: a database with workspaces of all statuses, orgs and org_members rows
tests.when: for any non-admin caller (api_key or PAT, with or without binding, empty or set UserID) and any workspace W
then: W is in ReadableSlugs with access A exactly when AuthorizeWorkspace(W, NeedRead) succeeds with Access == A
tests.pseudocode: for caller in gen(): set,_,_ = ReadableSlugs(db,caller); for w in all: r = AuthorizeWorkspace(db,caller,w,NeedRead); assert (w in set) == (r.status==0); if r.status==0: assert set[w]==r.Access

tests.title: An admin token lists every workspace with access admin, ordered newest first
given: workspaces of several owners, one archived
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called with an admin token, with and without include_archived=true
then: archived workspaces appear only with include_archived

tests.title: A non-admin caller lists owned and org workspaces with the recorded access
given: U2 owns W1, belongs to org O whose workspace W2 is owned by U1, and W3 (archived) in O
W4 in an unrelated org
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called as U2, then with include_archived=true
then: first response holds W1 (owner) and W2 (member) only, newest first

tests.title: A caller with 501 readable workspaces receives all of them in created_at descending order
given: 501 workspaces readable by U2 with distinct created_at values
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called as U2

tests.title: A caller with an empty readable set gets an empty array
given: a user who owns nothing and belongs to no org with workspaces
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called

tests.title: A PAT without a read-implying scope gets 404 before ReadableSlugs runs
given: a PAT with only tokens:read scope for a user whose org_members table is missing, so any readable-set query would fail with 500
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called

tests.title: A bound PAT lists at most its bound workspace and only if its user may read it
given: U2 is a member of O containing A and B; PAT bound to A; PAT bound to C that U2 cannot read
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called with each PAT
then: bound-to-A returns an array with only A (access member)

tests.title: A ReadableSlugs or by-slug query failure gives 500
given: a database in which the by-slug workspace load fails (or org_members is missing for a non-owner caller with org workspaces)
tests.when: GET /api/v1/workspaces is called as a non-admin user
then: no workspace objects in the body

tests.title: Every workspace response carries access and org_slug
given: a workspace the caller owns, with a git-backed carry-patch configuration for sync
tests.when: create, get, list, update, archive, reactivate, sync (with carry-patch extras) and reclone are called
then: every response body (or list element) has the keys "access" and "org_slug"
tests.pseudocode: for r in responses: assert 'access' in obj(r) and 'org_slug' in obj(r)

tests.title: access describes the caller, not the PAT's scopes, and create says owner
given: owner U1 with a PAT holding only workspaces:read, an admin token, and a member U2
tests.when: GET /workspaces/W is called by each and POST /workspaces is called by U1

tests.title: org_slug is the org's slug, or null when org_id is NULL or the org row is missing
given: W1 in org O (slug 'acme'), W2 with NULL org_id, W3 with an org_id naming no org row
tests.when: GET each workspace as the owner
then: W2 and W3 org_slug is JSON null

tests.title: A member sees the same keys and values as the owner, apart from access, and no credential value
given: workspaces with varied org, upstream and credential settings
tests.when: for any workspace, GET /workspaces/W is called as the owner and as a member
then: the key sets are equal and hub_url is present for both
all values are equal except access
no field contains the stored credential value
tests.pseudocode: o=get(W,owner); m=get(W,member); assert keys(o)==keys(m); assert {k:v for k,v in o if k!='access'}=={...m}; assert secret not in json(m)

tests.title: lookupWorkspaceForAuth returns AuthorizeWorkspaceAt's decision and 404 if the row vanishes before the full load
given: a member, a stranger and the owner of W
a hook that deletes W's row after the access decision and before the full-row load
tests.when: a handler using lookupWorkspaceForAuth is called with NeedWrite for each caller, then with the row-deleting hook
then: the member gets 403 forbidden with the wsaccess message; the stranger 404 "workspace not found"; the owner succeeds
with the row deleted in between the answer is 404 "workspace not found"

tests.title: A member reads the workspace, the patch list and a patch
given: U2 is a member of W's org; W has a patch; U2 uses an api_key and a PAT with workspaces:read
tests.when: GET /workspaces/W, GET /workspaces/W/patches and GET /workspaces/W/patches/:id are called

tests.title: A member's workspace, sync, reclone and patch writes are refused with 403 and change nothing
given: U2 is a member of W's org; PAT scopes sufficient for each route
a snapshot of workspace rows, patch rows and the clone job queue
tests.when: PATCH /workspaces/W, POST archive, POST reactivate, DELETE /workspaces/W, POST sync, POST reclone, POST patches, PATCH/DELETE patches/:id, POST patches/reorder, POST patches/:id/restore and POST patches/:id/reset-to-origin are called
then: rows, git refs and job queue are identical to the snapshot

tests.title: A PAT bound to another workspace gets 404 and one refusal report with method and route, even for a member
given: U2 is a member of B's org; a PAT of U2 bound to A; an observer
tests.when: GET /workspaces/B (through lookupWorkspaceForAuth) and a route of B guarded by BindingGuard are called
then: one report per refusal, carrying method and route as TS-34-58 expects
the reports equal those before this spec

tests.title: carrypatch and merge helpers pass a Need and write refusals through WriteRefusal
given: a member, a stranger and an owner on W
tests.when: authorizeWorkspace (carrypatch), authorizeMergeWorkspace and validateWorkspaceForMerge (merge) are called with read and write needs
then: member + read passes; member + write writes a 403 with error_type forbidden
stranger gets 404 {error: "workspace not found"} without error_type

tests.title: A member reads rebuilds, preview, patch-status, rerere and merges like the owner
given: U2 is a member; W has a rebuild, a merge and rerere entries; U2 holds the scopes each route needs
tests.when: GET rebuilds, rebuilds/:id, rebuild-preview, patch-status, rerere, merges and merges/:id are called by U2 and by the owner
then: every member response is 200 with the same body as the owner's

tests.title: A member's rebuild, rerere and merge writes are refused and enqueue, cancel or delete nothing
given: U2 is a member with the needed scopes; a queued rebuild and merge job; rerere cache entries
tests.when: POST rebuild, DELETE rebuilds/:id, POST rebuilds/:id/requeue, POST rebuilds/:id/rollback, DELETE rerere/*, POST merges, DELETE merges/:id, POST merges/:id/requeue and POST rebase are called
then: the job queue and the rerere cache are unchanged

tests.title: runCarryPatchSync authorizes with NeedWrite
given: a member and an owner of W with a carry-patch workspace
tests.when: runCarryPatchSync is exercised through the sync route for each

tests.title: The lease write flag and forge access values map to the right Need
given: a member on W
tests.when: LeaseService.authorize(c, false), authorize(c, true) and forge authorize with readAccess, writeAccess and writeAnyStatusAccess are called
then: write=false and readAccess pass for the member
write=true, writeAccess and writeAnyStatusAccess give the member 403

tests.title: A member lists and gets leases with unredacted secret names
given: a lease on W whose secrets and optional_secrets name entries; U2 is a member with the read scope
tests.when: GET /workspaces/W/sandboxes and GET /workspaces/W/sandboxes/:id are called by U2 and the owner
then: 200 for U2 with bodies equal to the owner's including secrets and optional_secrets

tests.title: A member cannot issue or delete a lease
given: U2 is a member; a recording sandbox backend stub
tests.when: POST /workspaces/W/sandboxes and DELETE /workspaces/W/sandboxes/:id are called by U2
then: no lease row is created or destroyed and the backend is called 0 times

tests.title: A member's forge reads use the workspace credential and never leak its value
given: U2 is a member with forge:read; W has a configured forge credential; a stub forge server
tests.when: GET forge, forge/repository, forge/deliveries, issues, issues/:n, issues/:n/comments, pulls/:n, pulls/:n/state, pulls/:n/files, pulls/:n/checks and pulls/:n/reviews are called
then: the stub forge received the workspace credential on the outbound calls
credential in the body is only its kind
no response body contains the credential value

tests.title: A member's forge writes and webhook changes are refused without outbound calls
given: U2 is a member with forge write and webhook scopes; a stub forge server counting requests; a webhook configuration
tests.when: POST issues, PATCH issues/:n, POST issues/:n/close, POST issues/:n/comments, POST issues/:n/labels, DELETE issues/:n/labels/:name, POST labels, POST pulls, POST pulls/:n/comments, PUT forge/webhook and DELETE forge/webhook are called

tests.title: A stranger on any workspace secret or variable route gets 404 workspace not found in the apikit envelope
given: a stranger on W; secrets and variables exist on W
tests.when: every workspace secret and variable route (including vars/resolved) is called by the stranger
then: each answers 404 with body {error: "workspace not found"} and no error_type

tests.title: A member gets the stranger's 404 on every workspace secret route and learns no name
given: W has a secret named 'db_password'; U2 is a member with secrets scopes
tests.when: POST and GET .../secrets and PATCH and DELETE .../secrets/:key are called by U2
then: each answers 404 {error: "workspace not found"}, byte-identical to a stranger's body
the body contains no secret name

tests.title: A member lists workspace variables like the owner
given: W has variables; U2 is a member
tests.when: GET /workspaces/W/vars is called by U2 and the owner

tests.title: A member's resolved variables equal the owner's document, with the org tier only while the owner is an org member
given: user, org and workspace tier variables; owner U1 is a member of O; U2 is a member of O
tests.when: GET /workspaces/W/vars/resolved is called by U2 and by U1; then U1's org_members row is removed and both call again
then: 200 and the same document for both calls in each round
the org tier is present in the first round and absent in the second

tests.title: A member's variable writes are refused with 403 and change nothing
given: U2 is a member with variable write scopes; W has variable 'K'
tests.when: POST vars, PATCH vars/K and DELETE vars/K are called by U2
then: variable K is unchanged and no variable was added

tests.title: A member minting or listing bound tokens gets 404 and no token is created or shown
given: U2 is a member with tokens scopes; W has existing bound tokens
tests.when: POST /workspaces/W/tokens and GET /workspaces/W/tokens are called by U2
then: the list body shows no token

tests.title: Mint still refuses bound PATs and admin tokens before the workspace lookup, with spec 34's answers
given: a bound PAT, an admin token and an observer
tests.when: POST /workspaces/W/tokens is called by each, including for a nonexistent W
then: status, body and refusal reports equal those of spec 34 (bound PAT refused as bound token; admin token 403)
the answer does not depend on whether W exists

tests.title: A member write on an archived or inactive workspace gets 403, not 400
given: archived workspace W and a workspace with a non-active clone_status; U2 is a member; the owner for comparison
tests.when: U2 calls PATCH /workspaces/W (valid body), POST merges, POST rebuild and a forge write; the owner calls the same
then: an invalid PATCH body from a member still gets the body-validation 400 that precedes the ownership step

tests.title: A PAT without the route's scope gets today's scope answer before the workspace lookup, even for a member
given: U2 is a member; PATs of U2 lacking the scope each route needs; an unknown slug for comparison
tests.when: workspace CRUD routes and the patch, rebuild, merge, sandbox, forge, secrets and vars routes are called
then: the other routes answer today's 403 without error_type
the answer is the same for an existing and an unknown slug

tests.title: A stranger gets the same 404 on every route as before
given: a stranger and a workspace W with secrets, tokens, patches, rebuilds, merges, sandboxes and forge state
tests.when: for any route listed in this spec and any method
then: the status is 404 and the body is {error: "workspace not found"} (secrets and variables in the wsaccess wording)
the body equals the body returned for an unknown slug
tests.pseudocode: for r in routes: resp = call(r, stranger, W); assert resp.status==404; assert resp.body == call(r, stranger, 'nope').body

tests.title: Owners and admin tokens get today's answers apart from the added fields
given: the existing ownership suites with fixtures updated to include org_id and org_members
tests.when: the owner and an admin token call every route of this spec in a personal-org workspace
then: statuses and bodies equal today's, ignoring the new access and org_slug keys
existing ownership test assertions pass unchanged

tests.title: A member gets the stranger's answers on session, cost, audit, SSE, transcript and git routes
given: U2 is a member of W's org with the needed scopes
tests.when: U2 calls the session, cost, per-run audit, unified audit query, SSE and transcript routes and a git clone/fetch of W
then: each status and body equals what a stranger gets today

tests.title: A member finds a teammate's workspace in the listing and reads its patch stack
given: the hub running with real handlers and database; U1 owns W in org O; U2 is a member of O with an API key
tests.when: U2 calls GET /api/v1/workspaces, then GET /api/v1/workspaces/W/patches
then: the listing is 200 and contains W with access "member" and org_slug of O
the patch call is 200 with W's patch stack

tests.title: A member's rebuild request is refused with 403 and no job is enqueued
given: the hub running with carrypatch routes, the job queue and a real database; U2 is a member of W's org with the rebuild scope
tests.when: U2 calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/W/rebuild
then: 403 with error_type "forbidden" and message "org members have read-only access to this workspace"
no rebuild row and no job queue entry exist

tests.title: A member gets the stranger's 404 on secrets and tokens
given: the hub with secrets and boundtoken routes on a real database; W has a secret and a bound token; U2 is a member; a stranger S
tests.when: U2 and S call GET /workspaces/W/secrets and GET /workspaces/W/tokens
then: both calls answer 404 "workspace not found" for U2
U2's bodies equal S's bodies and reveal no secret name or token

tests.title: A removed member loses read access on the next request
given: the hub running with real handlers and database; U2 is a member of O and reads W
tests.when: U2 calls GET /api/v1/workspaces/W (200), U2's org_members row is deleted, and U2 calls GET again
